repos_data.description: A Python library for anomaly detection across tabular, time series, graph, text, image, and audio data. 60+ detectors, benchmark-backed ADEngine orchestration, and an agentic workflow for AI agents.
Open-source, low-code AutoML platform for Python. PyCaret 4.0: sklearn-native engine + React control plane.
ML powered analytics engine for outlier detection and root cause analysis.
Streaming anomaly detection in Python: 16 online detectors (xStream, LODA, RS-Hash, Half-Space Trees, RRCF…) plus calibration and prequential evaluation for real-time data.

A distributed Spark/Scala implementation of the isolation forest and extended isolation forest algorithms for unsupervised outlier detection, featuring support for scalable training and ONNX export for easy cross-platform inference.

An open-source MCP server that turns LLMs into condition monitoring assistants for reliability engineers. It gives your AI assistant evidence-based vibration diagnostics: machine fault detection, severity assessment and diagnostic reports, for faster predictive maintenance decisions. Also available as a Claude Code plugin.
Implementation of Visual Feature Attribution using Wasserstein GANs (VAGANs, https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.08998) in PyTorch
Lightweight Docker monitoring dashboard with anomaly detection & Telegram alerts. One-liner install, zero config.
Self-hosted 4D spatiotemporal AI platform built on PostgreSQL, PostGIS, TimescaleDB, H3 and pgvector, with anomaly & threat detection, NLQ interface and full observability.

This project is an educational, pure JavaScript library featuring 400+ ML algorithms, designed to help developers and students explore how machine learning works under the hood, without the magic of external libraries.
A detective for your data. Zero-config data quality monitoring — works with dbt, Postgres, BigQuery, Snowflake. No YAML.
Python SDK for WaveGuard  physics-based anomaly detection API. One call. Any data.

Detects structural waste in cloud billing exports (AWS/GCP/Azure) using rolling-median + MAD, robust to the masking effect that breaks mean+stddev anomaly detection. Python library, CLI, FastAPI service, and GitHub Action.
GraphSAGE, GAT, GCN, GIN and LSTM from scratch in pure Python (zero dependencies) for fraud ring detection
